text: The Computative Economics framing replaces a preference holder choosing fixed alternatives with a generator-evaluator tuple whose activity produces the alternative set.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: The agent is not a preference-holder choosing among ﬁxed alternatives. The agent is a generator- evaluator tuple whose activity produces the alternative set in the course of operating. The quality signal is a functional on the generated possibility space, not an aggregate of preferences over realizations.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: the computative primitive described in the paper
